question: Can the remaining32 original n42–45 D4 requests yield independently checked certificates and rigorous named-instance LFD bounds on separate remote capacity?

claims.text: An independently accepted D4 certificate with checked codimension greater than the exact Boolean solution count establishes LFD>=5 for its exact named presentation.

arms.description: Run node-local controls, count, recheck retained candidate where available or run bounded original D4 producer, then unchanged independent checker.
Fresh exact count for each fixed original input.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact deterministic algebra and counts; no runtime comparison. Different chunk sizes are covered by software fixtures.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Exact checker, no statistical detector. Three complete worker reference fixtures match original certificate bytes and exhaustive counts; passing controls required on each scientific worker node. V2 additionally checks all3fixtures at a2=1 and an odd-degree pair at a2=0,1 with byte identity and full enumeration.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Full-worker controls cover codimension=count (no claim), retained-candidate reuse, resource refusal and corrupt certificate rejection. Software controls precede freeze; no negative scientific conclusion from missing certificates.

placement.checkpoint_detail: One job per input and immutable attempt prefix. Upload completed stages before later work. No restart while prior handle is live. Spot loss within a stage is censored, not a mathematical failure. v1 pilot failure remains visible; v2 is a distinct corrected attempt for the same original input.

stopping_rules.rule: Attempt all32 fixed inputs once; first submission is a transport/resource pilot. Failure remains visible; no substitution. An infrastructure retry requires reconciliation and a new retained attempt under amendment.
Resource refusal, timeout, invalid certificate or counter failure is retained without an LFD inference.

invalidation_rules: Any source, bundle, system or candidate hash mismatch prevents a claim.
Failed controls, checker or count prevent a bound.
Resource refusal, timeout, preemption or missing uploaded output remain unknown.
An unverified producer statement is not an LFD upper bound.

decision_rule.text: Independent D4 acceptance and exact_count < checked_codimension establish LFD>=5. This panel alone cannot establish LFD>=6.

inputs: public hash-pinned panel archive with32 requests and two retained candidates
outputs: Immutable per-input exact counts, checker transcripts, candidate bytes and conditional LFD bound; stage uploads.

graphs: Original input flow with remote continuation joined by prior_id; missing/censored inputs explicit.

inadmissible: Claiming LFD>=6 from this D4 panel.
Treating producer output or job success as independent certificate acceptance.
Counting retries or this continuation as additional independent samples.
Inferring a bound from missing or invalid output.

literature.claim: Constructive quotient-lift rationale, source review and remaining validation requirements.

changes: Use separately pinned v2 driver removing only the unsupported a2=0 wrapper restriction.
